findings.message: in an earlier version of this PR, you had to remove the `mem` import from the crate root to avoid an unused warning. won't that now trigger when building with cfi or kcfi?
findings.tp_fp_justification: tamird: under CFI/KCFI builds the mem import becomes unused (the transmute branch is cfg'd out), triggering an unused-import warning; author: 'Yes, good point. Updated.' (fixed by using the full path core::mem::transmute). The feature-gate removal comment (2042159720) was dropped as cleanup.
